realistic decisions moving forward my husband makes 100k a year thats including his 100 a day from his work per diem and i am about to be a stay at home mother in july we live in a nice camper paying car owl now offers cat s and cat n checks to help buyers understand insurance write offs car owl has expanded its vehicle history checking tools to include dedicated cat s and cat n checks these new checks are designed to help buyers clearly understand insurance write off markers and what they actually mean in real terms without confusion or fear based language cat s checks focus on vehicles that were written off due to structural damage these vehicles can legally return to the road after repair but buyers should understand what was damaged and how the repair was handled car owl now provides a clear way to review this status using its dedicated cat s check cat n checks cover vehicles written off due to non structural damage such as body panels electrics or interior components these markers do not indicate structural harm but repair quality still matters buyers can now confirm this status directly using the car owl cat n check both checks work using uk recorded insurance and vehicle data and are designed to be read as part of a wider vehicle timeline they do not replace inspections or test drives they help buyers understand what questions to ask before committing time or money by separating cat s and cat n into clear checks car owl aims to reduce misunderstanding around insurance categories and make used car buying more transparent and less stressful these additions sit alongside car owls wider vehicle history tools helping buyers build a clearer picture of a vehicles past before making a decision

what a cat n marker actually means and why it is often misunderstood a cat n marker means a vehicle was written off by an insurer due to non structural damage this usually includes things like body panels electrics trim or interior damage the key point is that the structure of the vehicle was not affected at the time of the write off decision many cat n vehicles return to the road legally after repair the marker does not mean the car is unsafe it means the insurer decided the repair cost was not worth it compared to the cars value buyers should treat cat n as a prompt to ask questions not a reason to panic what matters is what was damaged and how well it was repaired if you are considering a previously written off vehicle running a proper cat n check helps confirm the status early so you can decide calmly whether to continue

beware lg dishwasher xd3a25mb tldr deteriorates quickly not worth 1400au error codes are a rough guide 3 years ago i purchased an lg dishwasher and it was great plates glasses cutlery came out looking fantastic and the steam functionality was a really cool but over those 3 years i have never seen such an appliance deteriorate as quickly as this seals melting boards burning rubber housing cracking touch pads fading the whole works but anyway thats beside the point the main reason i wanted to post this is because i noticed there is a severe lack of information online with error codes and solutions the fault i was lucky enough to receive a couple of weeks ago was the ie error which is an inlet failure now the user manual gives a list of basic checks for this fault such as cleaning the water strainer in the hose connection ensuring you have water supply and nil leaks it also says to call a technician if those fixes dont work luckily enough i have an electrical background although i am not an expert in dishwashers i managed to get a copy of an authorised service technician handbook for this particular dishwasher the first thing to note is that the error codes are a rough guide it will point you in a general direction but its not overly specific think of it like plugging a scanner into your vehicle and it tells you that you have a cylinder misfire it could be a spark plug could be a vacuum leak could be low compression timing whatever you just know the cylinder is misfiring and theres a bunch of parts that allow it to function its similar to a dishwasher error code the authorised service book is like a cheat sheet it gives a series of components to check in order flow sensors solenoid valves and pcb board checks it also has the ability to access a test mode for your dishwasher this essentially tests individual parts by displaying component values on the interface depending on what youre testing anyway i was working through the steps and everything was passing but the last step was a physical inspection on the pcb main motherboard so i checked mine and surprisingly mine was burnt i then drove 40 minutes and picked up a brand new board installed it and tested the dishwasher started the dishwasher and the same error code appeared i opened up the service manual for the next step and there wasnt any wow this really could be anything ill double check everything i started throwing new parts at the problem i never recommend doing this but i was desperate i then looked at the dishwasher and saw the seals sagging some melted into the tray the faded touch pad and it hit me this thing is writing its own will in front of me so the moral of the story is that if you think you have a turd of a dishwasher sometimes the last tool you need is a trolley and a curb yes dishwashers are expensive but so are repairs and parts to keep it on life support my advice is if youve done the basic checks and a little more youve done well maybe consider a technician if you absolutely love the performance and quality but if it wants to die just let it die and invest in something with more resilience unfortunately not a happy ending for me but ill attach a link to the authorised service manual to hopefully help others in the future

copper market backdrop demand supply and financial catalysts copper has moved back to the center of global macro and industrial discussions as one of the most widely used industrial metals copper sits at the intersection of electrification infrastructure renewal and economic growth unlike many commodities driven by shortterm cycles coppers outlook is increasingly shaped by longterm structural forces and those forces come with clear financial implications demand drivers electrification at scale global copper demand is being reshaped by the energy transition and electrification of transport power and industry in 2024 global refined copper demand was estimated at roughly 27 million tonnes per year and is projected by multiple industry bodies to rise toward 33 million tonnes by 2035 with longerterm scenarios pointing to demand approaching 37 million tonnes by 2050 electric vehicles renewable energy systems and datadriven infrastructure are all materially more copperintensive than the systems they replace electric vehicles require roughly 24x more copper than internal combustion engine vehicles translating into an estimated 12 million tonnes of annual copper demand from evs alone by the mid2020s wind and solar installations consume significantly more copper per unit of energy produced than fossil fuel generation driven by cabling transformers and grid connections global electricity grid expansion and modernization is accelerating particularly in north america europe and asia as countries adapt networks for distributed generation and rising power demand as a result global refined copper demand is widely expected to grow at lowtomid singledigit rates annually through the decade driven primarily by electrification rather than traditional construction cycles supply side structural constraints are emerging while demand continues to rise the copper supply side faces growing challenges global mine production reached approximately 229 million tonnes in 2024 while refined copper output exceeded 26 million tonnes leaving limited margin for error in the supply chain the worlds largest producing mines are aging ore grades are declining and new largescale discoveries have become less frequent average copper grades at major global mines have fallen steadily over the past two decades increasing operating costs and capital intensity developing a new copper mine commonly requires 1015 years from initial discovery to commercial production permitting timelines environmental regulations and community engagement requirements have lengthened project development cycles across many jurisdictions industry groups have warned that without significant new discoveries and project approvals the market could face persistent supply tightness later this decade financial signals prices capex and investment flows copper prices have reflected these structural dynamics over recent years spot prices reached record highs near us11700 per tonne during 2025 highlighting concerns around future supply adequacy although prices remain cyclical in the short term longterm incentive pricing required to justify new mine development is widely viewed as higher than historical averages largescale copper projects often require initial capital expenditures measured in the billions of dollars making project scale grade and jurisdiction critical meeting projected copper demand under global energy transition scenarios could require more than us250 billion in cumulative investment and the development of dozens of new mines by 2030 major mining companies have increased capital allocation toward copperfocused acquisitions and project development signaling confidence in longterm fundamentals these financial trends suggest that future copper supply will depend heavily on successful exploration disciplined capital deployment and stable operating environments exploration as a catalyst in the copper cycle exploration sits at the earliest and
